ABOUT ME •

Somewhere between the classroom and the build.

I'm a Computer Science student specializing in AI & Machine Learning at Birla Institute of Technology, Mesra — currently among the top academic performers of my batch. I hold an Oracle Certified Generative AI Professional certification, and most of my time goes into building things at the intersection of AI, data, and cloud infrastructure.

Outside the classroom, I've worked with entrepreneurship and skilling initiatives through eDC, IIT Delhi and the Skill India Digital Hub — experience that taught me as much about people, communication, and execution as any lab ever did.
